name: GeneratorRules
lead: What `world.generate` takes. Without `height` and `density`, the rules add to the land the game's own terrain made.

fields.name: density
fields.description: Solid where this is above 0, for caves, overhangs and land in the air.

fields.name: sea
fields.description: Water fills the open air up to this y.

fields.name: floor
fields.description: The block at y 0; "bedrock" for a land of its own.

fields.name: biomes
fields.description: `{ "desert", when = field }`: the first that holds names the column's biome; one with no `when` is for the rest.

fields.name: rock
fields.description: The body of the land, under the ground rules.

fields.name: fluids
fields.description: What fills the caves: needs `density` or `carvers`.

fields.name: carvers
fields.description: The game version's own carvers, with the world seed, after the land and before the cave rules: "caves" (every version), "ravines" (b1.8 and later). Needs `height` or `density`.

fields.name: structures
fields.description: The game version's own structures, with spawners and loot: "mineshaft", "dungeon" (1.7 to 1.12). Needs `height` or `density`.

title: GeneratorRules type
